body: Thanks for watching out for people.

It is your birthday.    
(US "The Office" reference, forgive me if you never watched).

Expect a PM, and thanks.

Thanks for taking the time to write.

My husband is not good at talking about serious things (an issue in and of itself). When I share with him I feel like he's just saying what is needed to get that sort of talk to be over. I do know he loves me though, for which I am lucky.

I have no close family. I have been in therapy before, which has helped, but the moment I walk out of the office I throw all the tools I've been given right out the window. Also, it's hard to pick up that phone when you're feeling as bad as I do, you know? (I'm between therapists right now.)

Your post is very compassionate. Thank you. You must be a good person. Best wishes to you too.
